OpenAI and Nvidia Investment Process

Talks on Nvidia’s expected investment in OpenAI stalled due to disagreements over the business model and concerns from Nvidia employees. Although Sam Altman is seeking alternative chip makers, he stated that cooperation with Nvidia continues. Bloomberg reports that the investment could come in below previous expectations, at around $20 billion.

Intel and Activity in the Chip Market

As Apple evaluates alternatives outside TSMC in its supply chain due to rising costs, Intel returned to the agenda. Meanwhile, Intel is officially entering the market by bringing competition in the processor market into the GPU sector dominated by Nvidia.

SpaceX and xAI Merger

SpaceX incorporated Elon Musk’s AI venture xAI at a $250 billion valuation. After the merger, the goal was announced as establishing space-based data centers. xAI also released version 1.0 of its video generation model Grok Imagine.

Agentic AI and New Models

This week saw the following developments in autonomous agent technologies and model development:

  • OpenAI: A multi-agent-supported macOS app for Codex and the GPT-5.3-Codex model were introduced.
  • Anthropic: Claude Opus 4.6 was announced with a 1 million token context window and support for “agent teams”. Full Claude integration arrived in Apple Xcode.
  • Google: The Gemini app passed the threshold of 750 million monthly active users.
  • Perplexity: An advanced version of the Deep Research feature was released with a claim of SOTA performance.

Investment and Sector Data

The financial activity in the sector and other key headlines are as follows:

  • Cerebras Systems raised its valuation to $23 billion with its new investment.
  • Semiconductor startup Positron received $230 million in investment, while Fundamental received $255 million.
  • Mozilla is preparing to offer an option to completely disable AI features in the Firefox browser.
